districts.name: Inside the Single canal
districts.description: The busiest place in the city and super touristic, could be too crowded and annoying, I personally do not like to walk around but if you are first time there are must see places

places.name: Centraal Station
places.description: The main train station in Amsterdam, and a major transportation hub for the city, it might be overwhelming but it worth spend a few minutes there

places_to_see.name: The station building
places_to_see.description: The station building is a beautiful example of 19th-century architecture itest

places_to_see.name: Starbucks in old waiting room
places_to_see.description: Hidden gem of station, they preserved the design of the original waiting room. Unfortunately 1st class Grand Cafe is closed :(

places_to_see.name: IJ entrance
places_to_see.description: The entrance to the station from the IJ river, with a great view of the city and the river. You can also take a ferry from here to other parts of the city, including the popular NDSM wharf area

places.name: Dam Square
places.description: The heart of Amsterdam. This is the place where the city started

places_to_see.name: Royal Palace
places_to_see.description: The official residence of the Dutch monarch

places_to_see.name: New Church
places_to_see.description: (Not that new :) it is founded in the 15th century) A historic church that hosts exhibitions and concerts

places.name: Rokin
places.description: A street in the city center, with a lot of shops and restaurants also a nice metro station when you can see layers of amsterdam history when you go down to the metro station

food_options.name: The Seafood Bar
food_options.description: A restaurant that specializes in seafood dishes. If you like seafood, this is a great place to try some local dishes

food_options.name: Fulu Mandarijn
food_options.description: My favorite Chineese restaurant in Amsterdam. Not very touristic, and the food is really good. But I recommend to ask staff for recommendations, it can be too spicy sometimes

food_options.name: Van Stapele Koekmakerij
food_options.description: A bakery that specializes in chocolate cookies. They are iconic in Amsterdam, one of the touristic things that I love myself. It is a must-try for anyone with a sweet tooth

food_options.name: Broodje Popov
food_options.description: They make the best Philly Cheesesteak in Amsterdam

food_options.name: Blin queen
food_options.description: A place opened fellow Belarusians, not very Dutch but they make the best Blini in Amsterdam :)

places.name: Begijnhof
places.description: The quiet, historic enclosed courtyard in the heart of Amsterdam with historic houses and churches

places.name: De Wallen with red light district
places.description: The most famous area in Amsterdam, known for its legalized prostitution and nightlife... Most people know Amsterdam by its streets, but trust me it is not real Amsterdam experience :)

places_to_see.name: Oude Kerk
places_to_see.description: The oldest building in Amsterdam, dating back to the 13th century

places_to_see.name: Red Light Secrets Museum
places_to_see.description: A museum that offers a glimpse into the world of sex work in Amsterdam. I didn't visit it tbh, but people say it can be insightful

places_to_see.name: Zeedijk 1
places_to_see.description: If you want to see how the city looked like in the 16th century. The city used to be build with wooded houses. This is the only house that survived from that time

places.name: OBA Oosterdok library
places.description: The public library. It is free to enter and has a cafee on the top floor with a great view of the city

places.name: Damrak
places.description: One of the central streets in Amsterdam, connecting Centraal Station to Dam Square. It is too busy as for me, but you can see some iconic places there

places_to_see.name: Beurs van Berlage
places_to_see.description: A historic building that was once the stock exchange of Amsterdam. Dutch invented the stock exchange and Public Companies. Now it is a venue for concerts and events

places_to_see.name: Beurspassage
places_to_see.description: A shopping arcade. A beautiful place

districts.name: Herengracht, Keizersgracht, Prinsengracht
districts.description: If I want to walk in center of Amsterdam, that's where I go

places_to_see.name: Anne Frank House
places_to_see.description: It is a very popular place, so I recommend to book tickets in advance

places_to_see.name: Grachtenmuseum
places_to_see.description: Museum of canals, i still didn't visit it but heard it is very interesting

places_to_see.name: FOAM
places_to_see.description: Photography museum, love it, and you can also see how Amsterdam gardens look like

places_to_see.name: Tuschinski Theater
places_to_see.description: A historic cinema that is known for its Art Deco architecture. It is a beautiful place to watch a movies and it has amazing interiors. I think they have tours

places_to_see.name: Spiegelgracht
places_to_see.description: One of the most iconic view on Rijksmuseum

places_to_see.name: Magere Brug (Skinny bridge)
places_to_see.description: The iconic bridge in Amsterdam, it is an old drawbridge that opens to allow boats to pass through. It offers a nice view of the Amstel river

districts.name: Museumkwartier, Willemspark, Vondelpark
districts.description: The area with the most famous museums in Amsterdam, and a just a beautiful area to walk around

places.name: Rijksmuseum
places.description: The most famous museum in Amsterdam, with a large collection of Dutch art and history. It is a must-visit for anyone interested in art and culture

places.name: Van Gogh Museum
places.description: A museum dedicated to the works of Vincent van Gogh, one of the most famous Dutch painters

places.name: Stedelijk Museum
places.description: A museum of modern and contemporary art, with a large collection of works by Dutch and international artists

places.name: Vondelpark
places.description: The largest park in Amsterdam, it is a great place to relax and enjoy nature. It is also home to several outdoor cafes and restaurants

districts.name: De Pijp
districts.description: A neighborhood known for its diverse culture, trendy cafes, and the famous Albert Cuyp Market

places.name: Albert Cuyp Market
places.description: A market street. Good place to buy souvenirs and try local food. Here you can have a fresh stroopwafel, a haring sandwich, poffertjes and other :)

districts.name: Jordan
districts.description: Cute neighborhood area very, it used to be the place were workers used to live, but now as usual it is a popular area for expats and hight income specialists. Very cute and small area, with a lot of restaurants and bars, and a lot of shops. It is very cute place to walk around

districts.name: Nord
districts.description: The area that is across the river IJ, it is a bit more industrial and less touristic, but it has a lot of interesting places to see. You can take a free ferry from Centraal Station to get there

places.name: NDSM wharf
places.description: A former shipyard that has been transformed into a cultural hotspot, with street art, music venues, and festivals

places.name: A'DAM Lookout
places.description: An observation deck with panoramic views of the city, it also has a swing that goes over the edge of the building

places.name: Eye Filmmuseum
places.description: A museum dedicated to film and cinema, with a large collection of films and exhibitions
